gloss: several kinds; several types; a few varieties

definitions.gloss: several kinds; several types; a few varieties
definitions.explanation: An indefinite small number of distinct categories, typically two to nine. Combines {数|すう} (several) with {種類|しゅるい} (kind, type). Used adverbially with の to modify a noun.

examples.japanese: {数種類|すうしゅるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{試|ため}した→試す：02130_tamesu⟧。
examples.english: I tried several kinds of tea.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数種類|すうしゅるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{焼|や}いている→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
examples.english: This shop bakes several kinds of bread every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じて→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧{数種類|すうしゅるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{合|あ}わせて→組み合わせる：04659_kumiawaseru⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Depending on the symptoms, we prescribe several types of medicine in combination.

notes:
The prefix ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ attaches to counters to mean "several" — vague but small (typically 2–9). Almost always used attributively as {数種類|すうしゅるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数種類|すうしゅるい}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there are several kinds
- {数種類|すうしゅるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose from several types
- {数種類|すうしゅるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{試|ため}す→試す：02130_tamesu⟧: to try several varieties
